source_artifact.content_excerpt: cmd_collect merges the run branch into the operator tree with a bare no-ff merge and no check that the run branch content is still current. On a run that integrates by per-unit squash pull request rather than land, the run branch holds only the stale pre-run documents, so collect would regress main. Observed on the issue 847 run, where collect would have re-added 1566 lines and reverted 402 lines of mid-run plan amendment.
